label: Max temperature ≥ 40°C
advice: Stay hydrated, avoid outdoor work 12:00-16:00, check on children and elderly.

label: UV index ≥ 8
advice: Use SPF 30+, hat and sunglasses; avoid direct sun at midday.

label: Unhealthy air quality
advice: Wear an N95 outdoors; sensitive groups should stay indoors.
